title: sh pack test dictionary
author: hoshidicts
description: A tiny Serbo-Croatian dictionary written for the sh pack's lookup tests (no third-party data). Like wty-sh-en, it leaves the rules column empty. term_bank_2.json, written by sources/prefer-tests.py, has the two readings of each PREFER word of sources/build-own.mjs, with the gloss (test entry).
